title: The Mold in the Granary
text: Black mold blooms in the poorest House's granary, in patterns like writing, spreading across the sacks overnight. The granary cats will not go in. The mold has begun to grow along the beams toward the house, and the children say it whispers.

options.label: Burn the stock, mold and all, before it reaches the house.

outcomes.text: The stock burns with a smell like singed hair. The mold is gone, and so is the grain.

options.label: Scrape away the mold and save what you can. The House cannot spare the grain.

outcomes.text: Most of it is saved. The scrapers' hands are black for a month.
The mold comes back, worse, in the shape of handprints.

options.label: Leave it, and hope the cold kills it.

outcomes.text: It dies off in the cold, curled like something that was listening.
It spreads to next Year's seed. The bread from it tastes of cellars.
